name: digitalocean
description: Manage any DigitalOcean product, including Droplets, App Platform, Kubernetes, databases, networking, monitoring, and more.

skills.name: digitalocean
skills.description: DigitalOcean product guidance: pick the right service and skill, confirm which team is active, and pull current docs before acting. Use when the user says "on DigitalOcean", "my DO account", "which DigitalOcean product", or asks what to use on DigitalOcean without naming a servic

skills.name: digitalocean-app-platform
skills.description: Design app specs, deploy to App Platform, watch deployments, and read logs. MCP-only guidance (no doctl required). Use for "deploy my app", "App Platform", "app spec", "deployment failed", or "app logs".

skills.name: digitalocean-connect
skills.description: Connect the DigitalOcean MCP server, choose OAuth or a scoped token, and fix 401, 403, and 429 errors. Use for "connect DigitalOcean", "DO auth error", "token", or "permission denied".

skills.name: digitalocean-costs
skills.description: Price DigitalOcean changes before billable actions, and read balance, invoices, and billing history. Use for "how much will this cost", "my DO bill", "invoice", or "balance".

skills.name: digitalocean-databases
skills.description: Provision and operate Managed Databases: users, firewall rules, configs, backups, resize. Never echo credentials. Use for "Postgres cluster", "managed database", "DB user", or "trusted sources".

skills.name: digitalocean-droplets
skills.description: Create, resize, snapshot, back up, power-manage, and rebuild Droplets safely. Use for "create a droplet", "resize", "snapshot", "reboot my server", or "VM" on DigitalOcean.

skills.name: digitalocean-inventory
skills.description: Inventory what runs where and what it costs on DigitalOcean, and suggest cleanups for approval. Use for "what do I have on DO", "list my resources", "unused droplets", or cleanup recommendations.

skills.name: digitalocean-monitoring
skills.description: Uptime checks, alert policies, notification channels, and metrics queries via Insights. Use for "uptime check", "alert me when", "CPU alert", or "monitoring" on DigitalOcean.

skills.name: digitalocean-networking
skills.description: Domains, DNS records, certificates, cloud firewalls, load balancers, VPCs, and reserved IPs on DigitalOcean. Use for "DNS record", "point my domain", "firewall", "load balancer", "SSL cert", or VPC questions.

skills.name: digitalocean-safety
skills.description: Approval rules for DigitalOcean changes: what runs freely, what needs confirmation, what shows a price first. Loaded by other DigitalOcean skills; not usually invoked directly by users.

skills.name: digitalocean-troubleshoot
skills.description: Diagnose app errors, unreachable Droplets, database connection failures, and DNS issues on DigitalOcean, read-only first. Use when something is broken, down, failing, or unreachable on DO infrastructure.
